snippet.title: Spinning Scarecrow | Announcement trailer
snippet.description:
A new dark puzzle arcade game announced by IV PRODUCTIONS! 
 
The Spinning Scarecrow will spin on Steam in 2026!
Then, sooner or later, on consoles!

Spin and never rest: test yourself in a series of weird levels that will challenge your skill and concentration.

SPIN SCARECROW SPIN!

Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3409660/Spinning_Scarecrow/
